title: hooks/hooks.json
description: The canonical hook registry: each event maps to hook groups, and each group to the commands it runs, in Claude Code's hook format.
$comment: No dedicated validator reads this file; the schema encodes the shape the staging filter and the runtime adapters rely on. Event names are the canonical events every adapter declares; a sync refuses a runtime that does not map an event the registry uses. Hook objects stay open because adapters pass unknown keys through. Deliberately tighter than the code: type is fixed to command and timeout to a positive number, which no code checks but every adapter assumes.

matcher.description: Tool name pattern the group applies to; absent means every tool.

timeout.description: Seconds; adapters convert it to the runtime's own unit.
